page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a heading or title block at the top; no visible margin notes.
page.notes: The scan is a very small thumbnail (about 40×50 px). The text lines and any page number, running head or catchword cannot be read at this resolution, so they are omitted or marked illegible. The paragraph and line counts are estimates from the layout, not readings. Please provide a larger or higher-resolution image of the page for an accurate transcription.
